name: gh_workflow_runs_list
description: List workflow runs with repo/workflow/status/branch filters; status accepts run statuses or conclusions like the real API (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

workflow_id.description: The workflow file name, e.g. ci.yml or deploy.yml.

status.description: Returns workflow runs with the check run status or conclusion that you specify. For example, a conclusion can be success or failure; a status can be queued, in_progress, or completed.

branch.description: Returns workflow runs associated with a branch. Use the name of the branch of the push.

actor.description: Returns someone's workflow runs. Use the login for the user who created the push.

limit.description: The number of results per page (max 100). GitHub param: per_page. Default: 30.
